description_en: Retrieve an unpaginated list of comments for a merge request. Comments can be nested up to three levels deep
description_zh: 查询合并请求中的评论列表，不分页。其中，评论仅支持三级结构
name: ListMergeRequestComments

parameters.description_en:
A list of business IDs for the patch sets.

> Each comment belongs to a specific patch set. A global comment belongs to the latest patch set from the source branch.
parameters.description_zh:
版本业务ID列表

> 每个评论会关联一个版本，表示该评论发表在第几个版本，其中对于全局评论，关联的是最新的合并源版本。

parameters.description_en:
The type of the comment. Valid values:

- GLOBAL\_COMMENT: A global comment on the merge request.

- INLINE\_COMMENT: An inline comment on a specific line in a file.
parameters.description_zh:
评论类型

- GLOBAL_COMMENT：全局评论
- INLINE_COMMENT：文件行内评论
